items.title: Morning bus
items.body: Linh waits for the bus. She asks the driver for the next stop and sits near the window.

items.title: Market morning
items.body: Mia buys two apples and asks the price. The seller smiles and gives her a small bag.

items.title: Station delay
items.body: The train is late, so Nam checks the board and tells his friend they can wait in the cafe.

items.title: Workshop note
items.body: After the workshop, Hoa writes a short note about what the team decided and which task she will finish first.
